fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-11-30, around 08:30, the complainant reported constant unwanted calls at odd hours from a person who refused to stop, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-06. The online submission was made by Sathish Palanisamy (9000000238). The complaint mentions Kishore Arumugam, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000189, in connection with the events. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated calls and messages allegedly sent from the same number.
fields.Keywords: harassment, phone calls, mobile number, residential colony, suspect, morning, witness, phone records
